sourceTitle: No Bake Peanut Butter Chocolate Balls
sourceText:
No Bake Peanut Butter Chocolate Balls
By: LinKev
Published: Saturday, April 16, 2011 - 7:28pm

Ingredients




2 cups Reese's Puffs cereal crushed
2 tablespoons honey
2 tablespoons milk
2 tablespoons peanut butter
Presweetened cocoa to coat
powdered sugar to coat
You can also dip them in chocolate. I coated them with nutella

Preparation

1 In a bowl mix cereal, honey, milk and peanut butter. 2 Make balls the size of a quarter. 3 Roll them in the cocoa powder and or powdered sugar 4 Makes about 20

About


This is a great treat for kids. My kids loved it, especially with the nutella.
